stem.en: Which fundamental force is notably absent from the Standard Model's description of force-carrying particles?
stem.et: Milline fundamentaalne jõud on silmatorkavalt puudu standardmudeli jõudu kandvate osakeste kirjeldusest?

label.en: Gravity, which has no confirmed force-carrying boson within the Standard Model
label.et: Gravitatsioon, millel puudub standardmudelis kinnitatud jõudu kandev boson

label.en: The strong nuclear force, which the Standard Model does not describe at all
label.et: Tugev tuumajõud, mida standardmudel üldse ei kirjelda

label.en: The electromagnetic force, which has no known carrier particle
label.et: Elektromagnetiline jõud, millel puudub teadaolev kandeosake

label.en: The weak nuclear force, which is identical to gravity in the Standard Model
label.et: Nõrk tuumajõud, mis on standardmudelis identne gravitatsiooniga
